plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: My Library > Artists and Albums are now sorted alphabetically (albums by artist, then title), and all followed artists are listed, not just the first 500. Also: fixes the server running out of memory on small machines when two tracks start at once; real section names in New Releases; new icon; "Go to artist" / "Go to album" in every track's menu; tracks no longer stop early when a download is cut off; Podcasts menu hidden. Based on upstream 1.5.1, plus download priority within 2 downloads.
plugin.creator: schmij97, NikolajChristensen
